minor: 'fifteen months after Karma went on sale': 23 Oct 2016 to 8 Jan 2018 is about 14.5 months. The listed source says fifteen, so this is acceptable, but 'about fifteen' would be safer.

'the Mavic Pro had spent the whole holiday season on sale': Mavic shipments began in late 2016 and were supply-constrained for some weeks. 'on sale for the holiday season' is accurate, 'the whole season' is a little generous, and it has no sources entry.
'smaller when folded' (Mavic Pro) has no sources entry. It is true, but the comparison object is unclear (smaller than Karma?).

The 3 November forecast cut is placed after the 8 November recall, and the narration handles this correctly with 'had come first'. The 30 November cuts are framed as 'with the holiday quarter lost', but the sources attribute the 2016 forecast cut to production delays, not the recall.
'sold poorly' (Hero4 Session) is inferred from the price cuts and has no direct source entry.
'roughly fourteen months' for the three rounds of job cuts: 30 Nov 2016 to 8 Jan 2018 is about 13 months. The listed source says about fourteen.
